text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and B at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain; I should base each decision on my portfolio plan and risk allocation.","Because price changes are random, the recent moves in my account do not tell me what prices will do next; I should avoid treating short-term history as a signal.","My reluctance to admit a mistake can make losses feel harder to act on, so I should assess every holding consistently rather than letting purchase cost dictate whether I hold or sell."]}
